light: sun strikes the front of the cabin

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap white for the horizon glow and criss-cross outward
steps.load: tapped white on the brush
steps.motion: criss-cross strokes outward from the horizon
steps.rule: the horizon must be the lightest area for a sunset

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add cad yellow glow in the bright band
steps.load: a small amount on the brush
steps.motion: tap and rock back and forth
steps.where: the bright band, away from the blue
steps.rule: keeps yellow out of the blue, which would turn green

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add yellow ochre to the bright band
steps.load: mixed on the brush
steps.where: the bright band, away from the blue

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: dab floater clouds in crimson and blue
steps.load: much more crimson than blue
steps.motion: let them float with the same stroke
steps.rule: more crimson so yellow does not turn them green

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: rock a dry brush to blend the clouds
steps.load: dry brush
steps.rule: a wet brush would mix colors into mud

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap in distant tree shapes at the horizon
steps.load: load both sides full
steps.rule: letting some stay lighter makes it look like light shining through

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: pull light tree trunks on the dark canvas
steps.load: a tiny bit of white on the brush
steps.rule: light paint shows strongly on the dark base

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy areas back here with a 2in brush
steps.load: cad yellow and sap green mixed on the brush
steps.motion: tap downward and let it slide
steps.rule: water sits in a low spot, so a hill shows why

steps.subject: land
steps.action: tap highlights of yellow ochre and indian yellow on the hill
steps.load: mixed on the brush

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull grassy reflections straight down
steps.load: a little tap on the brush

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: add a touch of white so the water sparkles
steps.load: a little white on the brush
steps.rule: keep the white light so it does not overdo it

steps.subject: land
steps.action: scrub a bank along the shore line
steps.load: a little roll of the mix

steps.subject: stream
steps.action: close the grass into a little stream
steps.load: carries the dark mix

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint a big tree that leans off the top
steps.load: carried dark mix
steps.motion: push the tree out of the brush
steps.rule: tilting the tree leads the eye into the painting

steps.subject: land
steps.action: add a peninsula with a white highlight and dark shadow
steps.load: tiniest bit of white
steps.motion: touch a highlight and set a shadow under it

steps.subject: water
steps.action: sparkle the water with cad yellow and white
steps.load: a little cad yellow with white

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a crooked tree trunk through the big tree
steps.load: a roll of brown on the knife, a touch of white
steps.rule: a crooked tree usually has a crooked trunk

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add sparkling leaf clumps on the limbs
steps.load: mixed yellows and red on the brush
steps.motion: tap clumps and let the sun shine through

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in the cabin front in sunlit colors
steps.load: red, white and yellow ochre on the brush
steps.motion: block in and highlight the front
steps.rule: the front faces the sun so it is bright

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: shade the other side of the cabin with brown and white
steps.load: brown and a little white
steps.motion: make small slabs, dab a door

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: bounce the knife down the cabin side for siding
steps.load: small mix of red, sienna, white and ochre
steps.motion: bounce the knife down the side

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: paint grass around the cabin base

steps.subject: path
steps.action: add a little path with brown
steps.load: a little brown on the knife
steps.where: path in front of the grass
